Overview
Ignite your career as an early-career Data Scientist, playing a pivotal role in designing, building, and deploying innovative solutions that deliver tangible business value. description_preview:
Join Hiredbuddy as an Associate Web Developer and help build and maintain responsive, user-friendly websites. Work remotely with a collaborative team, learn modern web technologies, and grow your career in a supportive environment.
Full Description
About the Role
Hiredbuddy is looking for an enthusiastic and motivated Associate Web Developer to join our remote engineering team. As an entry-level developer, you will work closely with senior developers and designers to create, update, and maintain web applications that deliver exceptional user experiences. This is an excellent opportunity to launch your career in web development while contributing to real-world projects used by clients across various industries.
What You'll Do
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
Write clean, well-documented, and maintainable code using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Develop responsive web pages that perform seamlessly across devices and browsers.
Assist in the implementation of front-end frameworks such as React or Vue.js under the guidance of senior developers.
Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality and adherence to best practices.
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve issues reported by users or identified during testing.
Work with version control systems like Git to manage code changes and collaborate effectively.
Stay up-to-date with emerging web technologies and industry trends, applying new knowledge to ongoing projects.
Support the team in optimizing website performance, accessibility, and SEO.
Communicate progress, challenges, and solutions clearly with team members and stakeholders.
What You'll Learn
Practical experience with modern front-end development tools and workflows.
Best practices for responsive design, cross-browser compatibility, and web accessibility.
How to work in an agile development environment with sprints and iterative delivery.
Effective collaboration using project management tools like Jira or Trello.
How to integrate RESTful APIs and handle asynchronous data.
Fundamentals of back-end technologies (Node.js, PHP) and databases (MySQL, MongoDB) as needed.
Professional communication and problem-solving skills in a remote work setting.
Who You Are
You are a recent graduate or self-taught developer with a passion for building things for the web. You have a foundational understanding of core web technologies and are eager to learn from experienced mentors. You are comfortable working independently in a remote environment but also enjoy collaborating with a team. You pay attention to detail, take ownership of your tasks, and are proactive in seeking feedback to improve your skills.
Why Join Hiredbuddy?
Hiredbuddy is a dynamic company that values innovation, collaboration, and personal growth. We offer a supportive culture where every team member is encouraged to share ideas and take initiative. As an Associate Web Developer, you will have direct access to mentorship and professional development resources that will accelerate your career trajectory. Join us and become part of a team that is shaping the future of digital experiences.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience)
Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Familiarity with version control systems like Git
Understanding of responsive design principles
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
Excellent written and verbal communication
Ability to work independently and manage time effectively
Eagerness to learn and adapt to new technologies
Benefits
Remote work flexibility
Health, dental, and vision insurance
Paid time off and holidays
Professional development stipend
Collaborative and inclusive team culture
Opportunity for career growth

— not a manual process.
You will architect the automation layer that connects our CRM, marketing platforms, product telemetry, support systems, and financial workflows into a scalable, real-time operating environment.
Your Mandate Is To
Maximize revenue impact from CRM data and workflows
Reduce human-dependent workflows
Reduce latency between signal → action in the revenue funnel
Operationalize GTM strategy through automation, orchestration, and AI
You will partner across departments and the RevOps functions to translate business strategy into production-ready workflows, data models, and integrations across the GTM tech stack.
Key Responsibilities
Design & Implement GTM Automation: Build and maintain scalable, end-to-end workflows across CRM (Dynamics 365), marketing, customer experience, and financial systems to streamline lead-to-cash and renewal-to-expansion processes.
Integrate Revenue Systems: Develop API-based integrations across the GTM tech stack to unify account, engagement, pipeline, and product usage data into a realtime operating environment.
Operationalize GTM Strategy: Translate segmentation, routing, scoring, and lifecycle management frameworks into automated system logic that reduces manual intervention and execution latency.
Enable AI-Driven Execution: Deploy enrichment pipelines and intent- or usage-based triggers to improve data quality, pipeline prioritization, and next-best-action workflows.
Key Skills
Technical: Proficiency in APIs, SQL, Python/JavaScript, CRM platforms, automation tools, and AI/ML basics.
Business Acumen: Deep understanding of sales cycles, marketing funnels, and customer acquisition strategies.
Analytical: Ability to interpret data, identify trends, and build actionable insights.

Education: BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
Revenue Integration: 1–4+ years building integrations or automation across SaaS platforms
Certifications: Certifications in Microsoft Dynamics 365. Power Platform preferred but not required.
Coding Proficiency: REST APIs, JSON data structures, SQL (data extraction and transformation), Python or JavaScript (Node.js preferred)
Workflows and Data: Experience with workflow orchestration or automation platforms. Familiarity with dbt or modern data transformation frameworks preferred.
Stack Experience: Hands-on experience with sales stack tools, including CRM (Dynamics 365), Power BI, Outreach, Gong, 6sense, etc.
